ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Shell Script Creation in Profile Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of shell scripts under the "profile.d" path.

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX(".*\\/etc\\/profile\\\.d\\/.*") AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.csh$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.sh$")))
